about.heading: About me
about.paragraph1: I have 7.5 years of experience in IT as a C++ developer.
about.paragraph2: Web development has interested me since the beginning of my career, and I'm now following that interest by growing into a frontend developer.

skillset.heading: Skill set
skillset.description: Experienced in creating practical projects across a range of frontend technologies and UI concepts. I maintain a continuous learning mindset, regularly exploring new tools and techniques to grow my capabilities.
skillset.peelMessage: Also, I'm interested in diving into:

projects.heading: Projects
projects.intro1: Three projects, three ways to see how I build for the web. Take a look, click around and try them out yourself.
projects.intro2: Fight through three increasingly hard levels in a fantasy jump-and-run, find out who your favourite Pokémon is in a Pokédex, or organise your tasks in a kanban board full of clever little features.
projects.intro3: Go ahead and give them a try!
projects.joinDescription: Join is an Angular application where users can sign in and then create and manage tasks and contacts, with all data stored in Firebase. Tasks can be moved between different statuses by simple drag & drop.
projects.sharkieDescription: Sharkie is a JavaScript application built around Object-Oriented Programming (OOP). It shows how to organize code with classes, inheritance and encapsulation, resulting in an application that is modular and easy to scale.
projects.pokedexDescription: Pokedex is a JavaScript project centered on working with a REST API. It shows how to request data from external APIs, process it, and render it dynamically in the interface.

testimonials.heading: Colleagues' Thoughts
testimonials.quote1: Neelima always greets everyone with a warm smile and never leaves a question unanswered – she asks actively and with real curiosity. In our team she was a dependable teammate who, with persistence and effort, delivered more than expected. I’m convinced she will give her best to reach her goals wherever she goes.
testimonials.quote2: Working with Neelima was a great experience! She is dedicated, hardworking, and always brings a positive attitude to the team. Her commitment and reliability made her a valuable part of our project.

contact.title: Ready to work together?
contact.paragraph1: I enjoy building accessible, responsive web experiences. If you have a project or role in mind, tell me a little about it.
contact.paragraph2: I’d be happy to discuss how my experience and skills could contribute to your team.

join.description: Join is an Angular application where users can sign in, create and manage tasks and contacts. Data is stored in Firebase, and tasks can be moved between statuses using drag and drop.
join.implementationDetails: This Angular application lets users manage tasks and contacts after signing in. The data is stored in Firebase, and tasks can be moved between statuses using drag and drop.

sharkie.description: Guide Sharkie through swarms of pufferfish and jellyfish, and face the final boss, the evil orca Stressed Willy!
sharkie.implementationDetails: Sharkie is built with JavaScript and follows Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles. Classes, inheritance and encapsulation keep the application modular and easy to extend.

pokodex.description: The Pokédex is a web application for browsing Pokémon and viewing detailed information. It loads data dynamically and displays it in an interactive interface.
pokodex.implementationDetails: This project focuses on JavaScript and using a REST API. It requests data from an external API, processes it and displays it dynamically.
